info.text:
Every economist in a Reuters poll, 100 of 100, sees a December rate hike.
For the Fed decision on Wednesday, Oct 28, 94 of 100 expect no change from 3.75%-4.00%.
The Fed raised rates Sept 16, its first hike since 2023, and big banks lifted the prime rate from 6.75% to 7.00% on Sept 17.
Most credit cards have variable rates built on prime. Example: on a $5,000 balance, each quarter-point hike adds about $12.50 a year.
Sources: Reuters poll (Oct 20, 2026), Federal Reserve, CNBC, U.S. Bancorp, Wells Fargo.
News and education, not financial advice.
